key_findings: Jeroen Krens (HSBC) elected ISDA Board Chair effective January 2025
FCA/BOE DRR pilot participation (2018-2019) with 6 other UK banks
NOT a FINOS member despite ISDA Board leadership
No CDM contribution or production DRR announcement
Unique 'Governance Gap' pattern - ISDA leadership without FINOS/CDM adoption
notes: Only Phase 1 bank with top ISDA governance (Board Chair) but no FINOS membership. Demonstrates that ISDA policy influence does not equal CDM technical adoption. Historical DRR pilot (2018-2019) did not translate to production.
